dsi:usage/page: The outermost application background behind everything; not cards or panels placed on it.
dsi:usage/surface: Containers placed on the page, such as cards, panels and layers; not the page itself and not floating overlays.
dsi:usage/overlay: Content floating above the page, such as menus, popovers and dialogs; not containers sitting in the page.
dsi:usage/scrim: The dimming layer behind a dialog; not the dialog itself.
dsi:usage/inverse: Surfaces with the opposite lightness of the theme (a dark tooltip in light mode) and the content on them; not content on a colored fill.
dsi:usage/on-fill: Text or icons on a bold, solid colored fill (a filled button) that must contrast with it at 4.5:1; not content on subtle tinted backgrounds, not inverse surfaces.
dsi:usage/field: Form inputs such as text fields and selects; not buttons or plain surfaces.
dsi:usage/link: Inline navigational text links; not buttons or plain text.
dsi:usage/categorical: Members of a set of distinct named colors for tags, avatars or series, where the hue is the meaning; not status colors.
dsi:usage/data-viz: Marks in charts and graphs; not interface surfaces or text.
dsi:usage/code-surface: Code blocks and editors: background, gutter, line numbers, diff lines; only for code, never for ordinary interface.
dsi:usage/state-layer: A translucent overlay that shows hover, press or focus on top of an element; not the element's own color.
dsi:usage/navigation: Navigation bars, menus and sidebars; not page content.
dsi:usage/skeleton: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads.
none:usage: General purpose: used across the interface, not tied to the page, cards, overlays, code, charts or any one context. Most text, icon and border tokens are general.
none:intent: No signal: neutral or structural color with no status, brand or action meaning, such as default text, borders and surfaces.
none:hue: Not a member of a named categorical color set: almost every token, including gray text and blue buttons, is none here.
none:emphasis: Not one step of a contrast-ordered ladder: the token has no subtle, default or strong siblings that order by contrast in every mode.
none:state: The resting state: not hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled, dragged or visited.
dsi:property/text: Text color only, in a system that ships separate icon colors; not a token that colors both text and icons.
dsi:property/foreground: One token that colors both text and icons; not a text-only token in a system with separate icon colors.
